name: Di Summa courtyard figs

location.address: Piazza Antonino Di Summa, courtyard of the former Di Summa hospital (ASL Brindisi), Brindisi

official_register.name: Alberi Monumentali d'Italia (MASAF), sheet 15/B180/BR/16 and 16/B180/BR/16; Regione Puglia list

access: Inner courtyard of an active ASL Brindisi health complex. No published opening hours or entry rule found. The ASL put up a protective gate round the trees, an information plaque and a red bench in Nov 2024 and held a public National Tree Day event there (schools, Comune, Carabinieri Forestali). Whether a walk-in visitor may enter the courtyard is NOT confirmed: writer/curator must keep access wording honest or hold.
transport: Brindisi centre: about 10 minutes on foot from Porta Mesagne / Piazza Vittoria; Brindisi railway station about 1.5 km (20 minutes on foot)

location_site.name: Di Summa hospital courtyard, Piazza Di Summa

verify_notes: Folded twins: MASAF sheets 15/B180/BR/16 (girth 585 cm, height 22 m, coords 40.636153,17.932186) and 16/B180/BR/16 (girth 420 cm, height 16 m, coords 40.636333,17.932411) are about 25 m apart in the same courtyard (Piazza di Summa); one standing place. Register girths as recorded in the national list; the 585 cm figure is the larger tree. Age 'about 100 years' is the ASL's own estimate (Quotidiano di Puglia 3 Oct 2024; QuiMesagne 19 Nov 2024), not a register measurement; derived range broad. Ficus macrophylla is also called Fico magnolioide / strangolatore; aerial roots form pillar-like structures. Recognised by Regione Puglia in autumn 2024 on request of ASL Brindisi's technical area; ASL director general Maurizio De Nuccio quoted: 'two living monuments'. Nov 2024: gate, plaque with historical and scientific notes, red bench under one fig (violence against women symbol) installed; National Tree Day event 21 Nov 2024. Alive: last evidence is those Oct/Nov 2024 reports (lifecheck.py NONE for imagery); flagged. Pin: register coordinates only, approximate, midpoint of the two. Two independent sources are really one story (ASL press release echoed by two outlets) plus the register; owner of ground = ASL (counts as one official source). No OSM tree node, no iNaturalist observation within 150 m, no geotagged Commons photo within 150 m found (Commons geosearch nearest files are Porta Mesagne, 150 m).
